talkingPoints.text: high coverage, smooth matte and long-lasting color for 24h

benefits.text:
BBIA Eau Matte Cushion is a solution for a smooth matte, naturally clear base that keeps a radiant, fresh look all day
Key highlights:
- High-density coverage technology with ultra-fine powder particles helps give excellent coverage of pores and imperfections
- Exclusive technology delivers long-lasting color that resists darkening for 24h
- Formula contains 67.6% skincare ingredients for a moisturized, smooth and comfortable base
- Vegan certified, gentle even for sensitive skin

howToUse.text:
Use the puff included in the cushion case to pick up an appropriate amount of product and pat evenly onto the face.
For areas that need extra coverage, a concealer can be used alongside for smooth, perfect skin.

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: High-coverage matte cushion, smooth matte and long-lasting color, suited to a polished base throughout a long day.

sellingPoints.text: SPF50+ PA++++; all-day coverage; resists dulling for 24h.

texture.text: Soft, smooth cushion foundation with high coverage that melds into the skin.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it offers absolute oil control, is 100% budge-proof, or absolutely does not darken on every skin type.
